a.lede: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.
a.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit

b.lede: The former CEO offered to return to his top role at the company after his resignation last week.
b.title: Nvidia says it doesn’t plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO
